meta.name: azure-enterprise-infra-planner
meta.description: Architect and provision enterprise Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions. For cloud architects and platform engineers planning networking, identity, security, compliance, and multi-resource topologies with WAF alignment. Generates Bicep or Terraform directly (no azd). WHEN: 'plan Azure infrastructure', 'architect Azure landing zone', 'design hub-spoke network', 'plan multi-region DR topology', 'set up VNets firewalls and private endpoints', 'subscription-scope Bicep deployment', 'Azure Backup for VM workloads'. PREFER azure-prepare FOR app-centric workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据工作负载描述自动设计并生成Azure基础设施代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是云架构师或平台工程师，需要快速规划并部署企业级Azure基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Automatically design and provision Azure infrastructure from workload descriptions

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 根据你对 Azure 云基础设施的描述，规划网络、身份、安全、合规等架构，并直接生成 Bicep 或 Terraform 代码。它会按 7 阶段流程产出方案，在批准后才生成部署文件，还会引用 Azure 官方最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你提出“规划 Azure 基础设施”“设计 hub-spoke 网络”“规划多区域灾备拓扑”等需求，或要求生成订阅级 Bicep/Terraform 部署时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个三层应用的 Azure 基础设施，生成 Bicep 代码
say.note: Claude 会进入规划流程，产出架构方案供你确认。

say.text: 设计一个 hub-spoke 网络，包含 VNet、防火墙和私有终结点
say.note: Claude 会生成网络方案和相关 IaC 代码。

say.text: 为我的 VM 工作负载配置 Azure 备份，输出 Terraform 配置

howto.what_en: Claude plans Azure infra (networking, identity, security, compliance) from workload descriptions and outputs Bicep/Terraform. It follows a 7-phase workflow, requires approval before generating deployment files, and consults Azure best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan Azure infrastructure, design hub-spoke networks, plan multi-region DR topology, or generate subscription-scope Bicep/Terraform deployments.

say_en.text: Help me plan Azure infrastructure for a 3-tier app and generate Bicep code.
say_en.note: Claude plans and gives an architecture plan for approval.

say_en.text: Design a hub-spoke network with VNets, firewalls, and private endpoints.
say_en.note: Claude produces a network design and the related IaC code.

say_en.text: Set up Azure Backup for my VM workloads and output Terraform config.
say_en.note: Claude plans the backup setup and generates Terraform files.
